name: reachinbox-email-scheduler
description: Full-stack Email Job Scheduler — ReachInbox Intern Assignment

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "API,WORKER,VITE" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:api --workspace=backend" "npm run dev:worker --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.render-build: npm run prisma:generate --workspace=backend && npm run build
scripts.render-start: npm run prisma:migrate --workspace=backend && EMBED_WORKER=true npm run start
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=backend
